sourceReviewNotes: All 12 paper pages, 20 scheme pages, seven first-occurrence special-font glyphs and all 30 final source figures visually checked. All 100 generated card records reviewed for context, marks, options and source dependence.
Official scheme downloaded with HTTP 200 from https://www.examinations.ie/archive/markingschemes/2013/LC021GLP000EV.pdf. Source hashes and page roles are pinned in the audit.

All ten Q5 parts, all eight National Grid passage tasks and all four complete 28-mark Q12 options are retained; no choice-combination expansion. Every passage card carries the complete passage, original photograph and source attribution.

Gravity apparatus keeps three complete 12-mark routes, each object6 plus both3-mark details. Measurements stay paired with their matching method. Refraction apparatus and measurements retain every complete alternative route.

Thermistor table retains all seven measured pairs. Its graph, graph-reading and relationship tasks carry complete data and graph instructions. The original guide curve is approximate and its inconsistency with several plotted points is explained.

All truck/car masses, speeds and collision diagrams remain available on each calculation. The original force substitution yields28.3kN whereas its printed result is27.8±0.2kN; guidance uses unrounded momentum and explains the inconsistency.

Interference tasks carry the original two-speaker diagram, signal frequency and earlier observation prompt. The definition card preserves both underlined terms. The original constructive/destructive diagrams accompany the diagram criterion.

Semiconductor charge carriers retain stepped6+2 marks; the magnetic-field experiment keeps common criteria plus one matching apparatus/observation route. The convection experiment keeps any-two apparatus as one3-mark criterion.

Both kettle calculations keep mass, specific heat capacity, both temperatures and three-minute interval. Energy382200J and power2123.3W guidance explains follow-through from the source rounded energy.

X-ray tube diagram retains all five component options, anythree at3 each plus one3-mark detail. Electron production and electroscope charging preserve complete alternative methods without summing route totals.

Atmospheric-pressure experiment retains three complete9-mark routes, each with both procedural actions. Diver solution keeps both depths, density, gravity, original diagram and published partial-credit methods.

Historical simplifications are explained in answer guidance: heat transfer during phase changes, fixed-frequency sound interference, CD/DVD/oil interference versus dispersion, full induction charging sequence, and Pu rather than the source P for plutonium.
